transcript: How do I improve at chess? How do I improve at chess? Well, the truth is, there are many ways to improve at the game of chess, but I bet you didn't know that nowadays you can even improve at chess by doom scrolling. And I am not just talking about my majestic videos. No, I am talking about actual tactical training for chess. You see, I recently discovered this app called Chess Shield that revolves around a very simple but brilliant idea. If you want to scroll, you need to solve. For example, Instagram right now is blocked, but I can press on solve a puzzle and open Chess Shield. So, let's try to solve it together. Okay, I can see that there is this pressure on D8. There is a tension between the queens, and I can give checks with this knight. So, we remove the defense of the queen, we give another check, and then we pick up the queen with check like this. And now I can unlock Instagram. I set it to unlock it for only 1 minute, but you can also select different amounts of times, what apps are getting blocked, and you can also have a look at the stats of your puzzles. Overall, I think this is a very cool idea.
